geeklist.title: Helping brother-in-law downsize after debilitating brain tumor **Final Items**
geeklist.description:
My brother-in-law is recovering from brain tumor surgery and has had debilitating after effects greatly limiting his motor function. As such, he has had to move to a much smaller residence. This limits his space for board games. Outside of specific games he has decided to keep, this auction is my attempt to try and help him find some new good homes for as much of his collection as possible.
The items in this list represent the remaining games that were not purchased from the original auction. Most of the items on this list have been marked down from their original price.
The last 26 items in this list are free with purchase of any other item on this geeklist.
End Date: 02/01/2026 Shipping: US Only Payment Options: Paypal/Venmo, BIN
1. BIDS: All bids must be in $1 increments. Items will have a combination of starting bid (SB) price and BIN (Buy It Now) price. Some may have one, but not the other. If someone BINs the item, bidding is closed. I will not accept bids below the SB price (offers excepted, see rule 2). Some items have Bundle & Buy Now (BUN) pricing. 2. OFFERS: All reasonable offers will be accepted, especially if buying multiple games and/or opting for local pickup. Contact me via GM if you would like to make an offer. 3. LOCAL PICKUP: Local pickup is strongly preferred around Atlanta. I live on the southside outside of I-285. 4. SHIPPING: Buyer pays shipping. This auction ships to U.S. only. I ship using PirateShip.com to ensure the best pricing. I will consolidate shipping if you win multiple items. Shipping is from 30252. A fee will be included to cover packing materials (boxes, bubble wrap, etc). 5. PAYMENT: Winning bidders will be contacted via GeekMail; all sales will go through the Marketplace so BGG will receive its 3% commission. All payments will be made through PayPal (goods & services). I can also accept Venmo. Contact me if you want to inquire about a different payment method. 6. GAMES: All games are complete (unless noted) and condition will be noted. 7. AUCTION END: The auction will end on Sunday, February 1st, 2026 sometime in the evening EST (to avoid sniping).
%SHIPSFROM% 30252, USA %SHIPSTO% USA, Local Pickup %AUCTIONEND% some point in the evening (US Eastern Time) on Sunday 02/01/26
geeklist.comment: Best wishes for your BIL's recovery.

item.comment:
ill take this one.. looks like it may be entertaining.... heres the info:
Politigaffes: The War on Error is an unreleased party card game that was attempted as a Kickstarter project in the past (exact year not specified in available records, but the campaign ran from January 15 to March 15). Key Details: Creator: Josh Koopman, based in Huntsville, AL. Description: It's described as a "crazy and outrageous party game where everyone runs for president, creating hilarious statements to gain voters' approval." The theme revolves around political gaffes (blunders or awkward statements by politicians), likely involving humor from campaign mishaps.

Dang, good job! I couldn't find anything on this. If you have the kickstarter link, I can perhaps initiate a new entry on BGG for that game. update: n/m, I found it https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/joshkoopman/politigaffes-the-war-on-error-0
So strange. Never funded on kickstarter, yet this copy exists that my brother-in-law owned.
Ah, looking at the comments section, it appears he ended up having 500 copies available for sale on Amazon.
